column1: # Canonical implemented source evidence transferred unchanged into the RPC-ready coprocessor contract.

column5: The checked coordinator now constructs exact coprocessor.Request bytes with an encoded kvrpcpb.Context, region epoch/peer, isolation, priority, cache flags, statistics flags, stale/replica metadata, task/resource/source/bucket fields, TiDB request origin, trace SourceStmt, and wrapper-owned scopes, timeout override, endpoint, replica mode, and read-byte prediction. Raw unary response bytes are fully decoded and classified as region, lock, other, batch, or success before the coordinator can mutate cache, paging, EMA, or in-flight ownership. Existing task/cache/paging authorities remain connected. Tests are authored but not executed here; sockets/gRPC, PD and live RegionCache, address/replica selection, retry source patching, lock resolution, retry/backoff scheduling, cancellation, TLS, rate limiting, real TiKV/TiFlash, and async dispatch remain open.

The bounded cache authority preserves key construction, disabling, admission, retained exact-key validation, Get and Set, response fields 7/8/9, hit restoration, miss insertion, and absent versus present-empty paging ranges; no live TiKV RPC invokes it, and Ristretto sampled-LFU, asynchronous visibility, aliasing, eviction metrics, and non-finite conversion parity remain open.

EMA math and concurrency connect to classic and next-generation response-byte extraction plus successful-page observation; the coordinator and all CopPagingState continuations share one Arc<ReadBytesEma> rather than copying independent estimators. Non-finite and out-of-range Go float-to-uint64 conversion remains open.
Complete first-middle-last representation, slicing, splitting, traversal, reset, formatting, safe protobuf conversion, and live retry/remain consumption execute without Go unsafe aliases.

Checked region coverage and separate raw bucket topology drive exact requested-range intersection; the pre-transport coordinator rejects nil/outside-region bucket matches and out-of-order residual ranges before they can loop or reach transport. Live cache invalidation, PD refresh, retries/backoff, panic diagnostics/re-panic, and the broader RegionCache implementation remain open.

Exact TiKV/TiFlash/TiDB/TiFlashCompute endpoint discriminants and the disaggregated TiFlash mapping execute as pure request metadata. Store/client construction, atomic replica seed ownership, network error conversion at SendRequest, sockets/gRPC, live endpoints, and Close remain open.

BackoffMetadata retains maximum sleep and exposes exact per-type count, per-type observed sleep, and total observed sleep maps without inventing timing side effects. Context/variables, client-go Backoffer wrapping, error conversion, sleeping, retry limits, TxnLockFast caps, and scheduling remain open.

All seven TiDB replica-read discriminants map exactly to client-go, including both closest modes becoming mixed and unknown values returning leader zero. No live replica selector, seed, store labels, retry fallback, or RegionCache is claimed.

Driver defaults are cloned before exact replacement options, PD dial-option metadata preserves max receive size, keepalives, timeout, forwarding, and metrics labels, and SourceStmt trace injection is a nil no-op that preserves unrelated fields. Global hooks/config mutation, client delegation, path parsing, PD/TLS/keyspace setup, store cache/lifecycle, safe point, RPC client, latches side effects, and network behavior remain open.
